meta.description: Business logic, tracked projects, and feature status

product.name: Codesidekick Mothership
product.purpose: Personal project management dashboard for a solo developer. Unified view of all active projects, integrations, invoicing, and AI tooling.
product.keyPrinciple: Manifest-driven — projects declared in code, no database required for project metadata

ccs.name: Claude Code Sidekick
ccs.description: CLI framework + agent system for AI-assisted development

athena.name: Athena
athena.description: DeFi trading platform — API gateway + signals + UI

home-infra.name: Home Infrastructure
home-infra.description: Home server, media stack, Home Assistant, Tailscale mesh

projectManifest.description: Manifest-driven project registry with typed configs per integration

dynamicProjectPages.description: Dynamic /projects/[slug] route that auto-enables tabs based on manifest integration flags

asanaIntegration.description: Fetch and display Asana tasks with progress bar and section grouping

shopifyIntegration.description: Fetch store meta, themes, and recent orders via Shopify Admin API 2025-01

invoiceBuilder.description: Full invoice CRUD with KV persistence. Line items, tax rate, auto-computed totals. Draft/sent/paid/overdue statuses.

ollamaIntegration.description: Local LLM client for daily briefings and activity summarization via phi3 model on iMac

dailyBriefing.description: 3-paragraph morning briefing generated by Ollama from active project list and recent activity

anthropicChat.description: Project-aware AI chat using Claude (claude-sonnet-4-5). Proxied through server to avoid CORS.

settingsPage.description: 4-tab settings UI: AI providers (BYOK + routing), Integrations (Asana/Shopify/GitHub), Appearance, Data (export/import/reset)

byokSupport.description: Bring Your Own Key — users can supply their own Anthropic API key via settings. Overrides server key.
byokSupport.note: Key transmitted in POST body to /api/anthropic/test, never logged

anthropicKeyTest.description: 1-token Anthropic ping via server proxy to validate user-supplied key

projectIntakeForm.description: 4-step new project wizard with AI-generated brief, task list, and ccsConfig JSON via Anthropic

dockerDeployment.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile for Coolify self-hosted deployment as alternative to Cloudflare Pages

ccsAgentSidebar.description: CCS chat embedded in sidebar via chatUrl manifest field + sub-nav link

kvStorage.description: Real Cloudflare KV namespace wired (KV_INVOICES). Local dev uses in-memory Map fallback.

githubFeed.description: Recent commit feed per project via GitHub API (GITHUB_TOKEN optional for private repos)

multiUserAuth.description: Currently personal/single-user only. Would require moving secrets server-side.

r2MediaStorage.description: R2 bucket binding mentioned in app.d.ts comments — for future file attachments

anthropic.purpose: Reasoning-heavy tasks: project intake AI generation, chat
anthropic.keySource: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env (server) or user BYOK via settings

ollama.purpose: High-volume, low-stakes, private: daily briefing, activity summarization

invoicingLogic.computedFields: subtotal, taxAmount, total — derived via computeTotals(lineItems, taxRate)
invoicingLogic.storage: Cloudflare KV: invoice:{pid}:{id} + index at invoices:{pid}
